-- Data Warehouse Expected
DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20221231;  ---249354536263.65398300000

WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TEST_20231107 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND @BusinessDate BETWEEN CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodStartDate,112) AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodEndDate,112)
), 

CurrencyConversion AS (
SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),CurrencyConversionTimestamp,112) = @BusinessDate
)

SELECT 
SUM(CASE WHEN BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount END ) AS BalanceAmountFull
FROM CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCPB
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCPB.PeriodStartDate = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON CAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCPB.CustomerAccountId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON FPA.FinancialProductId  = CAFP.ProductId  AND FPA.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%') AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')

DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20230110;
WITH  CurrencyConversion
AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' 
    AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),CurrencyConversionTimestamp,112) = @BusinessDate
 
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BalanceAmount END) TotalRelationshipExposureFull
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON  A.IsoCurrencyCode  = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId 
AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId 
WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' 
AND  @BusinessDate BETWEEN CONVERT(CHAR(8),A.PeriodStartDate,112) AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),A.PeriodEndDate,112)








-- Account Matching  

DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20221231 -- 2580915
SELECT BDG.FORACID, BDT.ACID, BDT.isActive, BDT.isLatest, Acct_name
FROM  BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE BDT 
INNER JOIN  BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID --AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE @BusinessDate BETWEEN CONVERT(CHAR(8),EOD_DATE,112) AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),END_EOD_DATE,112)
AND BDG.FORACID NOT IN (
SELECT CustomerAccountId FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TEST_20231107
WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' 
AND @BusinessDate BETWEEN CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodStartDate,112) AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodEndDate,112) AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP')

WHERE @BusinessDate BETWEEN CONVERT(CHAR(8),EOD_DATE,112) AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),END_EOD_DATE,112)

SELECT CustomerAccountId FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
